# Colour-literal / inline-stylesheet debt in ItemDatabase/, as measured on
# 2026-09-18 by tests/test_no_hex_literals_in_ui.py's own scanner.
#
# Why a baseline and not a clean scan: MASTER line 3 promises "aucun hex
# magique dans ui/ ou ItemDatabase/", and the Armory has not been tokenized
# yet -- that is its own wave (it has 22k lines of UI, 190 QSS selectors and
# its own stylesheet, and it never imports core.theme). Until then the honest
# form of the promise is a floor that may only go DOWN: adding a literal
# fails the gate, removing some fails it too, so the number here always says
# what the debt actually is.
#
# The numbers are this scanner's, not a hand count: `#` comments are stripped
# first, so they differ slightly from a raw grep.

hex = 201
qcolor = 23
rgb = 20
setstylesheet = 96
